# Retrieve captured log messages

<small>Source: [`R/utils.R`](https://github.com/DiogoRibeiro7/heteroTests/blob/main/R/utils.R) · Help: `?ht_log_history`</small>

Returns a data frame containing the timestamp, level and message for recent
log entries captured via [`ht_enable_log_capture()`](ht_enable_log_capture.md).

## Usage

```r
ht_log_history()
```

## Value

A data frame with columns `timestamp`, `level` and `message`.

## Deprecated

Deprecated since 0.14.0; see [`ht_enable_log_capture()`](ht_enable_log_capture.md). It still works and
warns.
